parole.significato: isolated living quarter, rustic housing, rural cottage, hovel, slum
parole.testo: From Ottoman Turkish ایزبه (izbe), from Russian изба́ (izbá), from Old East Slavic изъба, истъба (izŭba, istŭba), from Proto-Slavic *jьstъba., possibly from Old High German stuba (“stove, heated room”). Doublet of soba.

From Ottoman Turkish چار, from Russian царь (carʹ), from Old East Slavic цьсарь (cĭsarĭ), from Proto-Slavic *cěsařь, from a Germanic language, from Proto-Germanic *kaisaraz, from Latin Caesar. Doublet of kayser, Kayseri, and Sezar.
